events.feedback:
To turn this Walter's Viburnum (Viburnum obovatum) draft into a beautifully free-flowing narrative that breaks the standard botanical mold, you have some absolute storytelling gold already sitting in the raw data.

Here is how to elevate this profile so it reads organically from start to finish:

1. Lead with the "Florida Snow" Ecological Lifeline (Quick Hits)
The Critique: The nickname "Florida snow" is fantastic, but right now it’s buried in a standard bulleted list.

The Fix: Turn this into a dramatic seasonal headline. Frame it not just as a pretty white display, but as a crucial ecological alarm clock. It blooms in late winter when the rest of the flatwoods are still completely asleep—making it the ultimate early-season lifeline for native pollinators emerging into a barren landscape.

2. Spotlight the "Bait-and-Switch" Advertising Billboard (Reproduction)
